name: StageWebView
description: Webview library for Haxe on Windows (WebView2), Linux (WebKitGTK), macOS and iOS (WKWebView) and Android, with a public webview.WebView API, an optional OpenFL StageWebView facade, hidden webviews, PDF output, direct hxcpp bindings, and a HashLink hdll on Windows.
releasenote: Adds the Linux engine library for ARM64, so a framework that opens it on demand, as Lime does, can show a webview on ARM64 Linux as well as x86-64.
